zh: 七月，关羽北上打樊城，守城的曹仁缩在城里不出来。
en: JULY. GUAN YU MARCHES ON FANCHENG. CAO REN SHUTS THE GATES.

zh: 曹操派于禁带七军去救，庞德也跟着。
en: CAO CAO SENDS YU JIN AND HIS SEVEN ARMIES. PANG DE RIDES ALONG.

zh: 七军三万人左右，于禁是老将，庞德是出了名的猛。
en: THIRTY THOUSAND MEN. ONE OLD GENERAL, ONE FEARED ONE.

zh: 按纸面实力，这支援军不算弱。
en: ON PAPER, NOT A WEAK RELIEF FORCE.

zh: 庞德出征之前跟手下撂过一句话：
en: BEFORE HE LEFT, PANG DE TOLD HIS MEN:

zh: 今年我不杀关羽，关羽就得杀我。
en: “THIS YEAR I KILL GUAN YU, OR HE KILLS ME.”

zh: 他是抱着必死的心上的战场。
en: HE RODE OUT ALREADY RESIGNED TO DIE.

zh: 可他们扎营的地方选错了，樊城北边一片低洼地。
en: BUT THEY CAMPED IN THE WRONG PLACE, LOW GROUND NORTH OF FANCHENG.

zh: 八月连下大雨，汉水暴涨，北方的兵多数不习水性。
en: AUGUST. DAYS OF RAIN. THE HAN RISES. NORTHERNERS CANNOT SWIM.

zh: 水一上来，营帐、粮车、兵器全泡在泥汤里。
en: TENTS, CARTS, WEAPONS, ALL SOAKING IN MUD.

zh: 三万人挤在几个土堆上等天亮，等来的却是关羽的水军。
en: THIRTY THOUSAND ON A FEW MOUNDS, WAITING FOR DAWN. GUAN YU’S FLEET CAME INSTEAD.

zh: 船贴着水面过来，箭往下射。
en: BOATS SKIM THE WATER. ARROWS FALL FROM ABOVE.

zh: 于禁投降，庞德死战不降，被抓住砍了。
en: YU JIN SURRENDERS. PANG DE FIGHTS ON, AND IS BEHEADED.

zh: 三万曹军成建制地被关羽收下。
en: THIRTY THOUSAND TAKEN, UNIT BY UNIT.
